title: Lesson 2 Quiz: Key Single and Double Candle Patterns

questions.text: Which candlestick pattern is defined by an almost identical opening and closing price, resulting in a very thin or nonexistent body?
questions.explanation: A Doji reflects market indecision because the open and close are virtually the same.

questions.text: True or false: A hammer pattern provides the most reliable bullish signal when it forms at the top of an uptrend.
questions.explanation: A hammer is most meaningful at the end of a downtrend, not at a trend top.
